section.heading: Contract caused by mistake of one party as to matter of fact
section.html: A contract is not voidable merely because it was caused by one of the parties to it being under a mistake as to a matter of fact.
section.text: A contract is not voidable merely because it was caused by one of the parties to it being under a mistake as to a matter of fact.
